title: Explicit Poisson-Hadamard Zero-Free Region Inequalities, Quasiconcave Minorant Crossing, Rigorous Trudgian Stieltjes Bounds, and Comparison with Smooth Weil Weights
description: Paper VII of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Examines explicit de la Vallee Poussin and Stechkin zero-free region inequalities through the mirror-paired Poisson-Hadamard kernel K(d, delta, u). Proves that delta^2 |-> K(d, delta, u) is strictly quasiconcave on [0, 1/4] with sharp endpoint minorant K_flat(d, u) = min(K(d, 0, u), K(d, 1/2, u)) crossing at u_x(d) < d/sqrt(3), derives an unconditional plateau Stieltjes lower bound incorporating Trudgian's (2014) constant 2.510, logarithmic tail and concavity corrections, and u = 0 focal-pair de-duplication, and benchmarks honestly against Mossinghoff-Trudgian-Yang (2024), Korobov-Vinogradov, Platt-Trudgian (2021), and Heath-Brown (1992) smooth Weil weights.
